name: Clomid PCT

card.summary: Post-cycle therapy using clomiphene, a SERM that raises the body's own testosterone signalling, used by steroid and TRT users hoping to restore hormones and hold onto the muscle they built.
card.note: Rx-only drug banned in sport; recovery regimens in forums are not medical protocols.

quick.overview:
Clomid PCT is the practice of taking clomiphene (brand name Clomid) after a cycle of anabolic steroids or after stopping testosterone therapy. The goal people state is to restart natural testosterone production, which suppressed hormones can leave low, so that muscle, drive and training capacity come back.

Clomifene is a selective estrogen receptor modulator that blocks estrogen's feedback in the brain, raising LH and FSH. It is prescribed for ovulation induction and sometimes off-label for male hypogonadism. Its use as post-cycle therapy comes mainly from bodybuilding forums rather than approved guidance.
quick.how: Users in forums describe taking it, sometimes alongside tamoxifen (Nolvadex) or hCG, for several weeks after the last injection, and checking bloodwork afterward. Regimens vary widely between posters, and some report normal labs afterward while others report low libido or other complaints despite normal results. No dosing is given here.
quick.risks: Reported effects of clomifene include vision changes, headaches and hot flashes, and rarely liver inflammation or reversible hair loss. It is prescription-only in the US, UK and Australia and prohibited by WADA. Black-market and gray-market sourcing carries its own risks.

lead: Clomid PCT refers to the use of clomifene (clomiphene), sold as Clomid, as part of post-cycle therapy, the period after a steroid cycle or testosterone replacement when users try to restore natural hormone production. People pursue it to protect the physique they have built, since suppressed testosterone is associated in forum discussion with lost drive, lost training capacity and fear of losing muscle.[1][2]

Clomifene is an oral nonsteroidal selective estrogen receptor modulator. In the hypothalamus it blocks estradiol's negative feedback, increasing GnRH pulses and raising pituitary LH and FSH, which in men raises testosterone. Wikipedia reports it is sometimes used off-label for male hypogonadism as an alternative to testosterone replacement.[1]

On T Nation, users discuss clomid with nolvadex as the standard PCT, report bloodwork after cycles, and ask about stopping TRT; experiences vary, with some reporting normal total testosterone afterward and others reporting low libido despite normal labs.[2][3][4]

chain: Clomiphene blocks estrogen feedback in the brain
Higher LH and FSH signalling to the testes
Natural testosterone recovery after a cycle, intended to support training and muscle
angle.text: Users take it after cycles hoping hormones rebound quickly so that strength and size are kept. Outcomes are reported anecdotally and differ by person and by what compounds were used.

paras: Clomifene is a mixture of two isomers, enclomifene and zuclomifene, with mixed estrogen receptor agonist and antagonist effects. Its antiestrogenic action in the hypothalamus drives increased GnRH pulses and higher FSH and LH.[1]

Merrell Chemical Company scientists synthesised clomifene in 1956 and it was patented in 1959. It was approved in the US in 1967 as Clomid and became the most widely prescribed ovulation-inducing drug.[1]

sections.h: Use in looksmaxxing and bodybuilding communities
paras: T Nation threads show users planning PCT with clomid and nolvadex after cycles of testosterone and other compounds, with detailed disagreement over what works.[2][3][4] One poster who waited a month before starting clomid PCT reported normal labs yet low libido and low semen volume, and others in forums ask whether clomid or nolvadex is preferable after stopping TRT.[3][4] Wikipedia states clomifene can raise muscle mass in men and is banned by WADA, and can appear as an undeclared ingredient in black-market products.[1]
Wikipedia lists vision changes, headaches, hot flashes and abdominal discomfort as less common effects, and high triglycerides, liver inflammation and reversible hair loss as rare.[1]

Clinical studies of clomifene concern ovulation induction and male hypogonadism; Wikipedia notes much evidence for male use is secondary and that enclomifene may work better than the mixture.[1] No controlled trial specific to steroid post-cycle recovery is cited here.

timeline.event: Approved in the US as Clomid.[1]

lore.intro: PCT with clomid is a staple topic on T Nation, with users sharing anecdotes about recovery.[2][3]

claims.claim: A clomid and nolvadex PCT restores normal hormones after a cycle
claims.believers: One user reports total testosterone around 700 after standard PCT with clomid and nolva, better than before cycling.[2]
claims.experts: Clomifene raises testosterone in some men with hypogonadism, but evidence for this use is described as largely secondary.[1]

claims.claim: Normal labs can coexist with persistent symptoms
claims.believers: A poster reports normal labs but no libido and low semen volume after clomid PCT.[3]
claims.experts: No published study cited here tests this scenario.
